name: TUR Stake spot-priced power and unaccrued referral power
summary: The TUR Stake contract converts staked TUR into mining power from the spot reserves of the TUR/NOBEL and NOBEL/USDT PancakeSwap pairs, and credits 20% and 5% of that power to the staker's first two referrers by raising their power without adjusting their rewardDebt, so each referrer can immediately claim the new power times the whole accumulated reward per share. The attacker borrowed 1.9M USDT, bought NOBEL and TUR to inflate both spot prices, staked 840,992 TUR from an account bound under its own referrer accounts, and had those referrers claim, draining the contract's entire 18.8M TUR reward balance before selling it back to USDT.
notes: The project deployer's top-level creation installed the non-upgradeable Stake runtime; the constructor fixed both pair addresses used for pricing, and the runtime hash was unchanged through the exploit.

The Stake contract's TUR balance fell from 18797013.727945965666304686 at block 88871541 to 1 wei at 88871542. Of that, 589140.185415031974863037 TUR went as the 3% claim fee to the project fund wallet 0xb3026bdc58c591c1137a1fec9506915e39789923 (logs 20, 24) and is excluded, and the attacker's own 840992.452555100162463228 TUR staked in (log 23) is netted out, leaving 18207873.542530933691441648 TUR taken by the referrer accounts (logs 21 and 25 in, forwarded to the attacker at 22 and 26). The attacker's selling moved the TUR price, so the value is the realised gain: the EOA received 2033398.302560718774502099 USDT from the NOBEL/USDT pair (log 71) against the 1900000 USDT it put in (log 5) and repaid (75), a gain of 133398.302560718774502099 USDT, forwarded with 92.09 USDT of its own balance as 133490.392419136677677840 USDT to 0xef670d9c2e24d1788f39ad35c70f4cc51b4e5898 (log 77). USDT is valued at par; 76303.19 USDT of NOBEL transfer tax paid to 0x972bfaae4093baf00bd5b4db2e11d143adc16f97 during the sale is not counted.
